items.name: Monument to Endurance
items.oracle_text:
Whenever you discard a card, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn —
• Draw a card.
• Create a Treasure token.
• Each opponent loses 3 life.

•抓一张牌。
•派出一个珍宝衍生物。
•每位对手各失去3点生命。
